summary.text: Stella Pekarsky is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 36, serving since 2024.
The district covers part of Fairfax County.
The Senate biography lists George Mason University for education, with a B.A. and an M.Ed.

paragraphs.text: Stella Pekarsky serves on the Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources; Education and Health; General Laws and Technology; and Local Government committees.
